faq.title: FAQ
faq.uploadedAnswer: No. Supported tools process files inside your browser and do not upload them to this server.
faq.freeAnswer: Yes. No login, payment, or membership is required.
faq.mobileQuestion: Can I use it on mobile?
faq.mobileAnswer: Yes. Tool pages use a single-column layout and card results on small screens.
